findings.evidence: CFSGStatement/README.md lines 259–303 require Layer 9 and state that explicit classical matrix groups would leave the L0–L3 route and need a roadmap decision before work starts; Basic.lean lines 105–113 disclaim the required identification and define `AmbientGroup` as `TypeBSpinCarrier.points`.
findings.fix: First obtain a human roadmap change adopting this explicit-carrier-and-identification route, or defer this attachment until Layer 9 exists and define it through the required pinned construction.
findings.issue: `TypeBLieIndex.AmbientGroup` attaches an explicit matrix spin carrier while CFSG L0 explicitly requires the uniform Layer-9 pinned Chevalley–Demazure construction and rules out separate classical matrix carriers; the file itself confirms no identification with that pinned group exists.

summary: The new index-attached spin carrier is outside the roadmap’s currently mandated uniform pinned construction and cannot advance L0 until the roadmap explicitly adopts this route.
